findings.notes: Legacy namespaced generate rules allowed expressions to select resource types or namespaces before their scope could be established. Namespaced policies now require static scope-selecting fields while preserving dynamic resource names. Both variables and references are rejected in these fields, and live admission preserves fail-closed target authorization. This records the release-1.19-n4k code fix for the 1.19.2 security workstream; no patched enterprise tag or public release is asserted. Hold docs publication until advisory disclosure.
